summary: Machine-based post-processors now convert the F word of G84/G74 tapping cycles from thread pitch to feed rate (pitch × spindle speed) by default via a new overridable _tapping_to_speed hook, raising an error when S is missing or zero; the Tapping operation tags its cycle with an 'operation: tapping' annotation and the LinuxCNC post defers non-rigid tapping to this default.

pages.reason: Path/Post/Processor.py: new _tapping_to_speed hook called from _convert_drill_cycle; converts tapping F pitch to feed = pitch*S/60 and raises CAMAttributeError/CAMValueError for missing or zero S; subclasses can override

Path/Base/Generator/tapping.py: G84/G74 command gains 'operation: tapping' annotation; posted F is now feed rate (pitch × RPM) rather than raw pitch, and a tool controller spindle speed of 0 now errors at post time
Path/Post/scripts/linuxcnc_post.py: non-rigid G84/G74 now emit F as pitch×RPM via the parent conversion; rigid tapping still emits G33.1 with K pitch
Processor.py/linuxcnc_post.py changes are covered by the MBPP page; this page's machine-based section does not enumerate individual hooks
tapping.py generator change only affects the Tapping operation's command annotation; Drilling page text unaffected
